llm_response.reason: The website displays several scam characteristics: (1) No external presence or reputation in legit directories; (2) Lack of hyperlinks for customer service, privacy policy, and contact--indicating non-functionality; (3) Unavailable WHOIS info, hiding domain ownership; (4) Possible unauthorized use of the 'POM Amsterdam' brand; (5) Excessively high fake review counts on all products; (6) Use of urgency/sale tactics like 'Top Verkoper' and 'Hete Verkoop'. These together strongly indicate an attempt to defraud visitors rather than operate as a real e-commerce shop.
